list: Official 55-trophy list as published by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026)
platinumEstimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies (PowerPyx)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in order — story first (watching the one missable meditation in Chapter 1), then side missions, collectibles and activities, and finish with the 100% completion checklist. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough and no online trophies at all.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Follow the roadmap: story, side strands, collectibles, activities, then 100% completion.
Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends — the only missable step.
Keep cheats off the whole run: cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it; the trophy unlocks at the mission's end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is normally the first trophy a player earns.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1 and play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Complete the mission objectives as prompted.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before the chapter ends, do the meditation at Jason's house — it is the one missable step in the whole game (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play all Chapter 1 main missions to the end.
Before finishing the chapter, meditate at Jason's house (missable).

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete every main mission of Chapter 2; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Nothing in Chapter 2 itself is missable — the only missable trophy in the game is tied to Chapter 1.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play all Chapter 2 main missions through to the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish all main missions of Chapter 3. By this point the map is well opened up, so it is a good moment to start scanning vehicles and studying animals for the collectible trophies while travelling between missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play all Chapter 3 main missions through to the chapter's end.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel — progress counts toward later trophies.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete every main mission of Chapter 4. The story is split into five chapters and takes roughly 60–80 hours, so this is the long middle stretch — keep side strands and collectibles ticking over alongside it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play all Chapter 4 main missions through to the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of only two golds. Finish the final mission of Chapter 5 and this gold unlocks. After the credits there is still free roam, but there is no mission replay — so anything mission-tied should be finished before the finale, and the one missable meditation must already be done.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the story through Chapter 5 and finish the final mission.
Free roam continues after the credits; use it for cleanup.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission-named trophies like this one unlock automatically on mission completion — there is no extra requirement beyond finishing the mission itself.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears, then complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so the trophy pops on completion with no side requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Child's Play when the story reaches it.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears, then complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Headliners when the story reaches it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears, then complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown when the story reaches it. The VCIA airport area also matters for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so note the layout while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears, then complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory when the story reaches it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears, then complete it.

trophies.estimate: The long grind — most of the 200 hours
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the second gold. Attain 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which appears after the story — earlier progress still counts. PowerPyx stresses the thresholds are lenient: the checklist is closer to 60% true completion. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars; most side quests are not required. Most of it is earned naturally while chasing the other trophies, so leave this for last and mop up the checklist items that remain.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first; the checklist appears after it, but earlier progress counts.
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
Work the checklist top to bottom in free roam until it reads 100%.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and similar driving feats, tracked cumulatively. This is a volume trophy: it accrues naturally over a long playthrough, but it pays to drive aggressively and seek out jumps rather than fast-travelling everywhere. PowerPyx lists it among the three biggest time sinks on the road to platinum, alongside the 100% checklist and the WAiNK locations.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive everywhere instead of fast-travelling; stunts accumulate as you play.
Chain jumps, drifts and near misses on highways and ramps.
Check progress under Progress, then Stats.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The in-game tracker counts 9 types, viewable under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. You do not need to win or complete any of them — one attempt at each type is enough, so sample the cheapest or quickest version of each and move on.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see the 9 types.
Try one of each type, once — no win required.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy rather than a grind: learn each range's target pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and take your time on the timed lanes. Gold medals are per-challenge, so a weak lane can be retried on its own without redoing the rest.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit the shooting ranges and attempt each of the 42 challenges.
Retry any challenge that falls short of gold — progress is per challenge.
Use steady aim over speed on the precision lanes.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so work through them one by one; a win at a location counts even if other locations are still unbeaten. Learn each course's shortcuts and keep the drone low and fast on the straights.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida.
Win one race at each location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events rather than 20 wins at the same one. Spread across the race types you enjoy most; winning also feeds the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races across Leonida and win 20 different ones.
Track which races you have already won so none is repeated.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, and this is a head-to-head challenge against Cal — land the better catch under the challenge rules. If you lose, retry the challenge; nothing about it is missable.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take on the fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him to win the challenge; retry if you lose.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one you find and play it through to its end screen. This is one of the 9 activity types too, so it also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine in Leonida.
Play one arcade game through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand of side missions. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses; work through Andy's missions in order until the strand's final mission is done. These character-final trophies are all unmissable as long as you keep taking the character's missions when they appear.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever they appear.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand of side missions. Follow the strand through in order; the trophy unlocks on the final mission's completion.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's missions whenever they appear.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand of side missions. Work the strand in order until its final mission is done.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Take Billy's missions whenever they appear.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side-mission chains given by minor characters around the map; each strand is several missions long. You need 8 full strands, which is more than the named character finals alone, so explore the map for stranger markers and work through them steadily. This is one of the silver trophies that takes real time, so start strands early rather than leaving all 8 for the post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Look for stranger mission markers across Leonida.
Complete 8 full stranger strands, mission by mission.
Character-final strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) can count toward the total.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand of side missions. Follow the strand through in order; the trophy unlocks on the final mission's completion.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Take Randy's missions whenever they appear.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand of side missions. Work the strand in order until its final mission is done.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. The first meditation spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter — PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it, and the game's own guidance says to do it before Chapter 1 ends. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the moment it is offered, then work through the remaining spots as they unlock. If you miss the first one, the trophy is locked for the playthrough (there is no mission replay).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

steps: CHAPTER 1, FIRST PRIORITY: meditate at Jason's house the moment it is offered.
Then meditate at every other spot as it unlocks — 18 spots across 10 locations in total.
Do not finish Chapter 1 until the house meditation is done.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a hunting strand task: track the specific animal Bret asks for, take it down, and return. Use the binoculars to study animals first — studying 100 of the 255 animals is also needed for the 100% checklist, so the two goals overlap nicely.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunting request.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names.
Study animals through binoculars along the way — 100 studied counts toward 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible type; a set is complete when every card in it is found. This is a long scavenger hunt, so collect cards whenever you pass them rather than leaving all three sets for the end. Card locations are a classic guide-map task — the sources below list the sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore — don't leave them for later.
Complete any 3 full sets.
Use the cited guides' maps for the last stragglers.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game social/photo activity: visit a location, open the WAiNK prompt and post from it. One hundred locations makes this one of the three biggest time sinks on the road to platinum (with 100% completion and 250 stunts). Fold it into normal travel — WAiNK at every new place you visit — instead of treating it as a separate 100-stop tour at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: WAiNK at every new location you visit, from the start.
Keep a running count; 100 locations are needed.
Mop up the remaining spots in free roam after the story.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and the 100% checklist needs any 70 of them, so this trophy unlocks on the way to A Long Road. Pick the easiest 50 first — combat, driving and exploration challenges you are already doing — and save the hardest for the checklist push.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Work through the challenge list, easiest first.
50 completed unlocks this; 70 are needed later for 100%.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Do it in open country where you can outrun the search, and avoid getting caught at the last moment.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and escape until the heat clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the robberies quick, and keep moving — the trick is the chain, not the loot. Losing the wanted level (or getting busted) between shops breaks the chain, so retry the run if it breaks.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob them one after another, without losing your wanted level.
If the chain breaks, set up and try again.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida. Vehicles are discovered by finding and entering them — or by scanning them, which also counts toward the 200 of 277 base-model vehicles the 100% checklist wants. Explore car parks, dealerships and the countryside; variety matters more than value.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Enter or scan every new vehicle you see.
Aim for variety: 100 distinct vehicles.
Scanning also feeds the 100% checklist (200 of 277).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus during a firefight with at least 5 enemies present, and chain the kills before the focus ends. Pick a busy shootout rather than a quiet one, and use a weapon that drops enemies fast.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a firefight with 5 or more enemies.
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). In plain terms: leave the airport in a way the airport did not schedule — take a plane and get out without following the normal departure. Try it in free roam, when you can experiment without a mission's constraints.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA airport in free roam.
Get a plane and leave the airport without a scheduled departure.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank — expect this to involve the Rhino, either driving one or dealing with one at high wanted levels. Tanks show up when the heat is at its highest, so this is a late-game free-roam stunt: get the army's attention and survive the Rhino's arrival.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Raise the heat to the level where Rhinos deploy.
Engage the Rhino encounter and survive it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan it like a stealth job: case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out and try again rather than fighting through it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without being detected; if spotted, retry.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a full robbery job: get in, crack the vault, grab the take and escape clean. Five of them makes this a silver — work through them across the game, and use a fast getaway vehicle and a planned escape route for each one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find and rob a bank vault, then escape.
Repeat for 5 vaults in total.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. A fast car and a planned route make the escape far easier than a running gunfight.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Take the cash, then escape the police.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks areas as you visit them — drive, walk and fly into every corner, including the outlying countryside and the islands, until the area count is complete. This pairs naturally with the WAiNK locations, the meditation spots and the vehicle scanning, so fold it into the same exploration runs.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Visit every region of the map — 52 areas in total.
Use the map's area tracking to find the gaps.
Fold it into WAiNK and collectible runs.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang, nine in total. Learn where each gang operates, then work through the list gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang — nine robberies in total.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a small world moment: go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the early guides — PowerPyx marks it as not yet known — so try the beachfront bars and the cocktail spots along Ocean Drive until it pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a cocktail spot with a view.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the classic GTA showroom escape. Drive into (or out of) a vehicle showroom and break through the glass and out onto the street. The early guides have not pinned down the exact showroom yet, so try the main dealerships in Vice City.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Go to a vehicle showroom in Vice City.
Smash your way out through the front in a vehicle.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that specific alley and play through — follow-through suggests completing a game or a proper run of throws there, not just walking in. Bowling is also one of the activity types, so this counts toward Master of None as well.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling, following through on your throws.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a relationship-moment trophy tied to the duo's partnership — it unlocks from a story or free-roam beat involving Jason and Lucia together, not from a checklist. Play the story and the partner activities and it will come; the early guides have not pinned down the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play partner activities and story beats with Jason and Lucia together.
The trophy unlocks from a partnership moment — keep playing the duo's content.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count toward this one — the official list's count runs to 500 — so it is a volume trophy for making decisions across the game: dialogue choices, approach choices and moral choices as they come up. Just keep choosing; it accrues across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue and approach choices all count.
PSN tracks the count to 500; keep choosing across the playthrough.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is a retry trophy: fail something, then succeed on the second attempt. The early guides have not pinned down exactly which activity it tracks, so it is likely to pop naturally — fail a challenge or mission attempt once, then pass it on the immediate retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt at a challenge or activity, then pass it on the immediate retry.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is an easter-egg style trophy — witness something strange in Leonida. The early guides have not pinned down the exact event, so treat it as an exploration trophy: poke around the odd corners of the map, the remote spots and the weird roadside encounters, and it will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore the odd and remote corners of Leonida.
Trigger the strange event when you find it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a target and knock them down with a melee attack from the vehicle — the bowling pun is the clue: it is a drive-by, but with a melee weapon instead of a gun. Line up a slow pass, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the knockdown.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Drive past a target and knock them down with a melee drive-by.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists and cannot be spent directly — take them to your contacts to launder them into clean money. Keep laundering as you earn; the $250,000 is cumulative, so every robbery feeds it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn marked bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — weapons, clothes, food, vehicle upgrades — and it is cumulative across the whole game. You will spend a lot of this naturally on gear for the other trophies; if you are short at the end, buy and upgrade vehicles until the total clears $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend at shops as you play — weapons, clothes, upgrades all count.
Top up with vehicle upgrades if you are short at the end.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are buyable properties across Leonida — each one gives you storage and a place to keep the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Buy them as you can afford them; property money comes from the same robberies and laundering that feed the other money trophies.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy garage properties as you earn money.
Purchase all 8 to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register them in the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery/rideshare app. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the ones you find while exploring; it pairs with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find vehicles around Leonida.
Register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app.
